scope: Dedicated bag pocket for cultivated and mutated berries; final Mutator berries remain equippable by normal and corrupted Pokémon, ingredients remain crafting-only as confirmed by the user

checks: Classic berries remain in their own pocket without new ingredients or mutations
All new berries have one dedicated pocket; ingredients remain crafting-only
A corrupted Pokémon can equip a final Mutator berry from the bag with one authoritative debit
The team held-item picker also accepts final berries on a corrupted Pokémon and returns the replaced item exactly once
Held item and corruption survive reconnect; no client errors or viewport overflow
chromium.scope: Compiled client, real HTTP/Socket/MySQL, disposable corrupted Pokémon only. WebKit is not a physical iPhone test.
